facts.fact: Adam 夜里又多次梦见 Ian，每场梦都是未来的一帧片段快照，有些比其他的更糟。
facts.anchor: More dreams of Ian came and went in the night, each a snippet or snapshot of a future, some worse than others.

facts.fact: Jack 发来一份文件：Cole 与 Brandon Williams 同 “Lore” 往来的全部邮件——Adam 认定 Lore 就是 banshees 事件的元凶。
facts.anchor: Jack had sent a file, all of Cole and Brandon William’s emails with “Lore,” who had to be the one responsible for the banshees.

facts.fact: Jack 回复 Adam：仪式不在邮件里，他猜测是写在纸上的。
facts.anchor: No. They weren’t in the emails. I’m guessing they were on paper.

facts.fact: Emily 发来照片：Cole 书桌上的那几张纸看起来像画海盗地图用的，但确实全是空白。
facts.anchor: They looked like what you’d draw a pirate map on, but were, indeed, blank.

facts.fact: Adam 用 Sight 探查纸页：魔法的来源不明，但其“味道”冰冷、如冬、属于精灵。
facts.anchor: He did not know its source, who had cast the spell, but he knew its flavor. Cold. Wintery. Elven.

facts.fact: Argent 说被抹除的不只是书籍——还有圣像、雕像、马赛克：有人在编辑现实本身，抹去他们想隐藏的东西。
facts.anchor: “Yes, but it is not just books. It’s icons, statues, mosaics. Someone is editing reality itself, erasing what they want hidden.”

facts.fact: 面对 Adam“他不会……会吗”的追问，Argent 说她已无法断言——王冠已经改变了那个人。
facts.anchor: I can no longer say. The crown has changed him.

facts.fact: Adam 问 Archive Infinite 是否也受了影响；Argent 说无法确定，但至今只有精灵文献被改动，而 Archive 从来不属于精灵。
facts.anchor: “I do not, but so far only elven records have been changed. The Archive was never ours.
